notes: vibe's usage row plus task. input and output are required token counts; cache_read, cache_write and windows default to 0; cost_estimate, account and at are optional. at is when the usage happened (ms since epoch, at most one minute in the future and at most 30 days old); without it the service uses its receipt time. One row per (source, source_ref) per workspace, whichever connection sends it (a re-grant included), so source_ref must name the usage row itself, not the session: a repeat with the same figures (at included) applies nothing and returns the current roll-up; with different figures it is refused with receipt_collision. spent is the roll-up on the task across sessions: tokens = input + output + cache_write; cache_read is reported apart and never counts against an allowance; windows is the larger of the reported windows and the number of 5-hour windows with usage, by at or else receipt time (a window opens at the first usage after the previous one closed). request_id (optional, a UUID the client generates once per intended write) makes a retry safe: the same request_id with the same body from the same connection returns the original response and applies nothing; the same request_id with a different body is refused with receipt_collision.
